content = songs_file['content']
songs_to_archive = []
for line in content.split('\n'):

        # Format: "- Song Title by Artist"

        # Split on " by " (last occurrence)

        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists_page)
    if len(playlists_page) < 20:

    {"title": "Gone Astray", "artist": "Aria Sterling"},
    {"title": "Love's Aftermath", "artist": "Mia Sullivan"},
    {"title": "Journey to the Celestial Realm", "artist": "Dylan Stone"},
    {"title": "In the Chambers of My Mind", "artist": "Jasper Skye"},
    {"title": "Lost in the Echoes of Time", "artist": "Ethan Wallace"},

    {"title": "Weeping Sky", "artist": "Luna Starlight"},
    {"title": "Fading Like a Distant Star", "artist": "Hazel Winter"}
]

song_ids = {}
for song in songs:

    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(access_token=spotify_token, query=query, page_limit=20)
    # Find exact match
    found = None
    for item in results:
        if item['title'].lower() == song['title'].lower():
            # Check artist match
            artist_names = [a['name'].lower() for a in item['artists']]
            if song['artist'].lower() in artist_names:
                found = item['song_id']
                break
    if found is None:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {song['title']} by {song['artist']}")

        song_ids[song['title']] = found
        print(f"Found: {song['title']} -> {found}")

print("Total found:", len(song_ids))
